summary.intent: Execute Phase 27 (writable-shares-poc) of cipher-box end-to-end, implementing write-enabled folder sharing where recipients can upload, edit, rename, and delete files in shared folders.
summary.outcome: Phase 27 completed with all 3 plans executed and verified. Multiple critical bugs discovered and fixed during UAT (per-file IPNS records, dual-key wrapping, shared file save path, owner re-wrap propagation). A security review found 8 issues which were all fixed with TDD. 21/21 E2E tests passing, pushed to remote branch.

repo: cipher-box-ci-debug has no .env files — must copy from ../cipher-box/ or create from .env.example. The web app falls back to window.location.origin+'/api' when VITE_API_URL is unset, pointing to the wrong port.
Build dependency chain must be respected before starting web: core → sdk-core → sdk → web. Missing this causes 'cannot resolve @cipherbox/sdk' at Vite startup.

Two incompatible RequestWithUser types exist: common/types.ts (extends Express Request) and a local one in auth.controller.ts (extends NestJS/Fetch Request). Auth controller should use the shared one.
API client (packages/api-client) must be regenerated after any DTO change to keep OpenAPI enum values in sync — the generated ShareKeyEntryDtoKeyType enum doesn't auto-update.
GSD executor agents create SUMMARY.md and commit per-task; orchestrator spot-checks by verifying SUMMARY.md exists and grepping git log for phase-plan commit messages.
The share_keys table uses keyType enum constrained to 'file' | 'folder' in both the DTO @IsIn validator and @ApiProperty enum — both must be updated together for new types to appear in OpenAPI spec.
NestJS watch mode does not always pick up DTO changes to Swagger decorators; full restart required to regenerate the OpenAPI JSON spec.

code.finding: Shared uploads set fileMetaIpnsName: '' (empty string) — no per-file IPNS record was created. Files appeared in listings but could not be opened or edited. Fixed by inlining full IPNS keypair generation and publishing during upload.

Checks item.fileMetaIpnsName before opening — throws 'legacy v1 file' error for shared-folder files. Save handler used the owner's useFolder update path, not a shared path, causing 'Parent folder not found' error.

handleUpdateFile did not re-wrap the new file key for share recipients after owner edits. After an owner edit, recipient share_keys held the old file key — decryption failed. Fixed by calling reWrapForRecipients after every file content update.

withConflictRetry closures captured stale React state for currentSequenceNumber and folderChildren. Added refs alongside state; all four conflict-retry sites (upload, mkdir, rename, delete) use refs. navigateToSubfolder/navigateUp/navigateToBreadcrumb also didn't sync refs after navigation.

Subfolder keys were wrapped with the recipient's key during createFolder — owner permanently lost access to recipient-created subfolders. Fixed to wrap with owner's key in the FolderMetadata, plus add a share_key for the recipient.

updatePermission (downgrade path) did not delete file-ipns share_keys — downgraded recipients retained IPNS private keys and could still modify file metadata. Fixed by deleting keyType='file-ipns' share_keys on downgrade. Also missing revocation check — could upgrade a revoked share.

Polling loop unconditionally called setSharedItems on every tick even when permission was unchanged, causing unnecessary re-renders. Fixed with a permission-change guard. Also: share keys cache was not cleared on unmount.
Write-share recipients were allowed to add 'folder' keyType entries to shares they don't own. Fixed by restricting addShareKeys to 'file' and 'file-ipns' types only for write-share recipients.

workflow: Dev servers must be started as detached processes (nohup &) rather than background tasks — background tasks are killed when conversation context shifts, taking the server down with them.

TDD red-green flow: stash partial fixes, write failing tests against unfixed code to confirm they fail, pop stash, verify tests turn green. Provides confidence that tests actually cover the fixed behavior.
When NestJS DTO validation (@IsIn) and @ApiProperty enum are both present, both must list the same values — a mismatch means the API rejects valid payloads even though Swagger shows them as valid.

Playwright E2E selector strategy: always verify CSS class names against the actual component source before writing tests. Component-specific classes (e.g. .shared-inline-input-field, .recipient-perm-write) often differ from generic guesses.
OTP codes for dev/test accounts can be retrieved directly from API server logs when needed during manual UAT.

friction: Background dev server tasks were killed repeatedly by conversation context shifts, requiring multiple restart cycles with escalating strategies (background task → detached nohup process).
PostgreSQL host IP changed mid-session (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12), breaking API connectivity. No .env in the CI-debug checkout made this harder to diagnose.
API client regeneration was required multiple times after DTO changes, and the OpenAPI spec only updated after a full API server restart (NestJS watch mode was insufficient).
Stale git lock file blocked commits, requiring manual removal.
E2E test selectors were wrong for 3 elements (recipient permission label, shared mkdir inline input, shared rename inline input) — required iterative run-fix-run cycles.

The dual-key IPNS wrapping required 3 separate bug-fix iterations: (1) no IPNS record at all, (2) record wrapped with recipient key only so owner couldn't update, (3) need for both owner and recipient copies.
The backend agent completed its work but the orchestrator had already moved on — partial stash/pop coordination was needed to maintain TDD ordering.
Transient Web3Auth Core Kit initialization timeout caused one full E2E suite run to fail and required a retry.
open_items: No PR was created — branch feat/phase-27-writable-shares is pushed but unmerged.
The /simplify commit/push was triggered at the very end of the session with no confirmation that it completed successfully.
uint8ToBase64 is a private unexported function in file-metadata.service.ts — the shared navigation hook inlined a copy rather than exporting it. Could be extracted to a shared crypto utility.

Pre-existing TypeScript errors in auth.controller.spec.ts and device-approval.controller.spec.ts were partially addressed (RequestWithUser unification) but the device-approval spec still has mock type issues.
Security finding H-02 (silent download fallback) was replaced with an explicit error, but the UX for 'share_key not found' errors is a raw error message — no user-friendly recovery flow.
30-second polling re-fetches the full shares list from the API on every tick — could be optimized to a single-share endpoint or use WebSocket/SSE for permission change notifications.
The E2E test for silent revocation (item 6 in UAT checklist) was not implemented in the test suite — 403 handling and [RW]→[RO] transition on next poll tick.
Phase 27 VERIFICATION.md was committed after the fact (discovered as uncommitted at end of session) — indicates the verifier agent's artifacts weren't staged in the main execution flow.
